youtube.title: Why do you still count time like a Babylonian? #Shorts
youtube.description:
You check the time about a hundred times a day and have probably never asked why it's built on sixty. Your phone keeps time to a fraction of a second, synced to atomic clocks, and it still counts like a Babylonian: sixty seconds, sixty minutes, 360 degrees on every map, compass and GPS. A Sumerian counting trick, an Egyptian sundial and a Latin translation. That's the hidden why. Full episode on the channel.

#Shorts #history #science #timeexplained #thehiddenwhy
